create_convert_document: create a conversion job for a document source and return the conversion result with options
run_convert_all_documents: run batch conversion on multiple document sources with concurrency control and error handling
submit_and_retrieve_many_tasks: submit many conversion items with controlled in-flight concurrency and retrieve responses
submit_async_conversion_job: submit an async conversion job for a document source and return a job handle for polling
test_service_health: test the docling service health endpoint and return the health check response
